Name: Bookseller Sells All Books (1.6 compatible)
Author: TaisceRayne
Description:
[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
No known issues with any other mods. If you have a mod that completely overrides the bookseller's shop list then I could see those conflicting.

[size=4][b]To Install:[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]! Just drag this bad boy into your mods folder and you should be good to go! If you want to change the prices, you can edit the config.json or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to edit it right in your game!

[size=4][b]To Uninstall:[/b][/size]
Delete it! Shouldn't cause any issues in current playthroughs, it only touches the bookseller's shop.

[size=4][b]Recommended Mods[/b][/size]:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20985]Self-Serve[/url] to access the shop even when he isn't there

Downloads.Description: Adds all books to Booksellers shop starting in year one, with configurable prices.

Manifest.Name: Bookseller Sells All Books
Manifest.Description: Makes all books available at the Bookseller starting in Year One
